title: Collatz: actual boundary dimension and source-clock estimates
body:
## Status

**Collatz remains OPEN.** This checkpoint proves new source-qualified dimension bounds for the actual canonical real boundary, formalizes seven finite and infinite probability components in Lean, and pursues two further direct closing attacks. It does not establish universal descent, escape exclusion, or exclusion of nontrivial positive cycles.

## Published checkpoint — 23 November 2026

### 1. Actual real-boundary law: upper local dimension one

For every fixed nonperiodic positive odd unit root, the actual critical trace inverse law's real boundary has upper local dimension one almost everywhere. The theorem also holds for the original whole-component ordinary boundary law and its bounded positive tilts. In particular these real measures are nonatomic. This extends the earlier support result to the supplied probability law itself.

The decisive new estimate is the whole-cone floor: a low trace value F(n)≤B forces every actual unit ancestor u≥(αδ/B)n. The distinct-path reciprocal bound then controls every real continuation by D·a_r^(1/40). Fixed-total integer endpoint separation and the original cylinder probabilities give a heavy-cell estimate; its sum over every valuation total is geometric. Two short legal unit parents and full-path selection supply the necessary good returns. An arbitrary-reference version of the estimate transfers to the common component law by conditioning on actual roots.

[Full written proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fcdcdbadc6172e414f7282442a8a6b85587d7e70/research/source-clock-20261123/BOUNDARY_OVERLAP.md). The canonical trace, positive floor, selection, and path-packing inputs retain their explicit source qualifications. No lower local dimension or uniform Frostman bound is asserted.

### 2. Positive lower Shannon information dimension at every fine scale

The exact low-profile clock tail is

```text
P_q(F(X_r)≤B, A_r≥6r) ≤ (B/F(q))·(64/81)^r.
```

It combines with selection and the heavy-cell estimate to give an all-scale mean information bound for the actual real law:

```text
liminf_k H_k(μ_E)/(k log 2) ≥ d_B > 0,
d_B = κ θ² / [2(2−θ) log(64/3)],
θ = (1−2/B)/(2/α−2/B),  κ = −log(1−3α/(64B)).
```

The same coefficient holds under every fixed absolutely continuous reweighting of a fixed-root path law, including integrable unbounded densities. Full-event selection extends by truncation; vanishing bad-event probabilities transfer by absolute continuity. Finite-root entropy concavity then gives the original component marginal. No root-uniform convergence onset or lower sample-path return frequency is assumed.

[Information-dimension proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fcdcdbadc6172e414f7282442a8a6b85587d7e70/research/source-clock-20261123/EXTENSIONS.md) · [Independent reconstruction](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fcdcdbadc6172e414f7282442a8a6b85587d7e70/research/source-clock-20261123/reviews/TARGET_EXTENSION_REVIEW.md).

### 3. Adaptive early trace and actual-target descent

[EARLY_TRACE.md](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fcdcdbadc6172e414f7282442a8a6b85587d7e70/research/source-clock-20261123/EARLY_TRACE.md) extends PR178's deterministic trace front to arbitrary almost surely finite inverse stopping rules, including independent randomization. Its exact terminal-D1 payoff bound shows that recovery of an order-one fraction requires positive canonical probability of reaching within a fixed distance of the original-source clock. A binary-KL inequality quantifies a changed law that forces an early payoff.

[TARGET_DESCENT.md](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fcdcdbadc6172e414f7282442a8a6b85587d7e70/research/source-clock-20261123/TARGET_DESCENT.md) tests Applegate–Lagarias's published semigroup theorem against the actual target. The all-length discrepancy identity has nonnegative terms. An integral word ending at one and matching every original-target parity must already be the actual orbit. The first parity mismatch must therefore be repaired to turn the semigroup theorem into target descent; that repair remains unproved.

[COLLISION_TRANSFER.md](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fcdcdbadc6172e414f7282442a8a6b85587d7e70/research/source-clock-20261123/COLLISION_TRANSFER.md) tests the dimension result against PR185's exact target. An explicit model density has exact local dimension one and Shannon information dimension one, but collision at least c·sqrt(m)·3^(−θ₀m). It is explicitly a model, not a Collatz law. Separately, the actual moving-root law retains a fixed positive high-profile mass from the original spine, uniformly in its inverse clock.

### 4. Seven Lean declarations

[BoundaryMass.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fcdcdbadc6172e414f7282442a8a6b85587d7e70/research/source-clock-20261123/lean/BoundaryMass.lean) proves four finite inequalities: the harmonic-term cone floor, selected-edge probability product, actual cylinder multiplier bound, and arbitrary-reference heavy-cell comparison.

[BoundaryBorelCantelli.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fcdcdbadc6172e414f7282442a8a6b85587d7e70/research/source-clock-20261123/lean/BoundaryBorelCantelli.lean) proves three measure-theoretic deductions using Mathlib's first Borel–Cantelli lemma: infinitely many surviving good returns, an increasing subsequence, and arbitrarily small real balls satisfying the power mass bound. The summable actual bad-event bound, good-return recurrence and scale convergence remain hypotheses to be supplied by the written argument.

### Remaining central estimate

The collision route still needs an upper bound on the entire actual ternary inverse-time law, retaining the original source and compatible clocks:

```text
Col_m(ζ_(M,r)) = o(sqrt(m)·3^(−θ₀m)),
m → ∞,  m² = O(M),  θ₀ = 0.949955527188… .
```

The new real dimension and information bounds do not prove this concentration estimate. The retained high-profile mass is explicitly accounted for. A successful legal target descent remains another possible route; nontrivial positive cycles also remain open.
